name: fast-harness
description: An opinionated coding harness with project-agnostic verification, browser E2E, worktree dev helpers, review-loop discipline, and safety-oriented workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable coding harness skills for verification, E2E, worktrees, review, and safety.
interface.longDescription: fast-harness packages reusable, secret-free workflow skills for local development: per-worktree service setup, code-level verification, real-browser E2E, cross-model review discipline, context hygiene, retrospective improvement, and small utilities. Claude Code-only hooks and slash commands remain available through the Claude plugin manifest; Codex installs the shared skills and supporting scripts.
